title: Tagged genesis recovery-incarnation proof
description: Objective: make a never-restored store's genesis fence a canonical self-proving public recovery identity without fabricating restore facts. Deliverable: refactor the landed recovery-incarnation mint/codec around an exact tagged context union (RESTORE with restoreCommandId+backupGenerationDigest; GENESIS with daemon-derived project/store context), preserve the existing restore API, and expose a synchronous or otherwise startup-composable genesis mint that returns full public SPKI/fingerprint/binding digest/signature proof while never serializing the nonce, private key, PKCS8, or handle. This is a prerequisite for task-e19074f841f9450296799abfba9bfcaa; the current genesis helper persists only refs plus a genesisDigest, while RecoveryIncarnationBinding requires restore-only fields that a fresh store does not possess. NOT in scope: SQLite installation/CAS, daemon startup/listener changes, restore quiesce policy, session lifetime, or using the key as signing authority. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run src/recovery/recovery-incarnation.test.ts src/identity/genesis-recovery-binding.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: The public recovery-incarnation contract uses an exact tagged GENESIS versus RESTORE origin; GENESIS cannot carry or counterfeit restoreCommandId/backupGenerationDigest, and RESTORE retains its current exact fields and behavior.

One production mint/verification implementation derives incarnationRef and keyEpochRef from fresh 256-bit entropy, complete Ed25519 SPKI fingerprint, and the tagged context, and returns a full canonical binding/proof whose signature verifies.

Genesis context is derived inside the daemon from the asserted project/store identity, never caller-selected recovery refs, counters, time, or restored bytes; repeated entropy/key material is refused with the existing exact recovery code/layer.

Canonical serialized public evidence contains no raw nonce, private key, PKCS8, key handle, bearer, or proof-of-possession secret; losing/unused key handles are destroyed and the result claims no signing/business authority.

Existing restore-incarnation, succession, anchor, and hostile-input tests remain green; generated GENESIS/RESTORE and mutation sweeps assert nonzero counts and removing either context or SPKI binding reddens focused tests.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck and the focused recovery-incarnation/genesis tests exit 0.
taskRails: Do not synthesize restoreCommandId or backupGenerationDigest for a never-restored store; model genesis as an explicit tagged origin.
Reuse the landed recovery crypto/freshness/self-proof discipline rather than a second generateKeyPairSync implementation.
This task proves only a fencing identity; it must not claim a durable usable signing key or persist/resurrect a private key handle.
Every refusal test asserts the exact stable reason code, layer, and component where exposed; mutation drills exercise the production verifier.
